record_type_quote: We utilized the same design and procedure as Busby et al. (2017), focusing this time on the 2016 College Football National Championship game.

targets.authors: Busby, E. C., Druckman, J. N., and Fredendall, A.
targets.title: The Political Relevance of Irrelevant Events.
targets.evidence_quote: We seek to replicate one of these studies (i.e., Busby et al., 2017).
targets.outcome_quote: Our results partially replicate the previous study and suggest the impact is constrained to a limited set of outcome variables.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall partial-replication verdict is reinforced by confirmation for the losing school and explicit failure for the winning school.
